statement: The public v5 history is a sanitized replay of the private v5 commits (frozen private head 27d4739). Files under 'derived' are PUBLIC DERIVATIVES, NOT byte-identical to the private originals: local machine paths were replaced (<WORKSPACE>, <CONDA_ENV>, <TMP>) or class-level official statistics were removed (per-crop / per-disease official accuracies, per-unseen-class results, the list of largest class confusions). Files under 'withheld' are not published (the 333 x 333 official seen confusion matrix). Stage SHA256SUMS manifests are published unchanged and record the PRIVATE ORIGINAL hashes. No per-image official prediction, official CSV, official image, checkpoint or feature cache is published; the aggregate official results (counts, Top-1/Top-5, H@1, H@5) are unchanged.
